svg.title: Comparison table: OmniRoute versus 9router, OpenRouter, CLIProxyAPI and LiteLLM across 13 capabilities.
svg.desc: OmniRoute is the only one with the full set: 388 providers, 150+ free providers built-in, 20 routing strategies, 12-engine token compression, a built-in MCP server with 110 tools, A2A protocol, persistent memory, guardrails, cloud agents, TLS fingerprint stealth, desktop/Termux/PWA, 67 UI locales and 100% MIT self-hosted. 9router has free providers, RTK compression and translation but no MCP, A2A, memory, guardrails, cloud agents or stealth. OpenRouter is a hosted SaaS with 400+ models, guardrails and a hosted MCP but is not self-hosted and lacks A2A, memory, cloud agents and stealth. CLIProxyAPI is a light OAuth proxy with two routing strategies. LiteLLM has 100+ providers, A2A and extensive guardrails but no memory, compression, free tier, stealth or cloud agents. Static-header comparison table where each capability row fades in top to bottom; the OmniRoute column is highlighted and shows a check or a leading value in every row, while competitors show a mix of checks, partials and crosses. Light and dark follow the viewer's color scheme.
svg.text: Every router does routing. OmniRoute does the whole platform.
full • partial • none · *OpenRouter counts models & is a hosted SaaS, not self-hosted.
